Commentary.Commentary: Okay! That ends a longggggg second ODI between Pakistan and Sri Lanka in Karachi. A quiet affair, with nothing happening outside the cricketing field. The third and final ODI will be played on Wednesday, 2nd October, 2019 at 3 pm local (1000 GMT). ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Pakistan captain, Sarfaraz Ahmed, is all smiles. On the big partnership blooming in the middle for Sri Lanka, Sarfaraz says that the bowlers need to work on being more consistent with their lines and lengths in the middle overs. With the bat, he wants batsmen to convert their starts and play a longer innings. On any possible changes for the final ODI, Ahmed says that he would like to play with his first-choice XI but also hints at giving a few chances to some new players.

Sri Lankan skipper, Lahiru Thirimanne, praises the effort by Jayasuriya and Shanaka but is disappointed with the way his team handled the first 10 overs with the bat. On his team's bowling, Thirimanne agrees that it was not bad but feels that they could have restricted Pakistan under 300. Stresses that the bowlers did well at few stages but towards the death, leaked a few runs. On the positives in this game, Lahiru cites Shehan Jayasuriya's example and looks out for more youngsters to make the most of these opportunities.

USMAN SHINWARI HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. Thanks the Almighty for enabling him to make a comeback after 6 months. Assesses the wicket to be on the slower side and hence, he resorted to bowling cutters. On him doing well against Sri Lanka, Usman smiles and says that he was hit for a lot in his debut, hence, he is returning the favour. On his efforts to come back into international cricket, Shinwari says that he bent his back really hard to come back and the Almighty helped him as well.

Earlier in the day, a clinical batting display from Pakistan got them to 305 after electing to bat. The openers laid a solid platform and then Babar Azam played a calm knock of 115 to keep Sri Lanka at bay. Please stay tuned for the presentation...

Usman Shinwari and Mohammad Amir used the new balls efficiently and made life miserable for the Lankans. Even though Usman got half the wickets of the entire team, everyone else, barring Shadab Khan was excellent. The leggie had a bad outing, going for 76 in a shade under 10 overs.

Shanaka's calculated attack took some pressure off Jayasuriya who then started to come into his own. However, some cramps then hampered the latter before he eventually got out. Also, the two occasions of the light tower failing hampered the Lankan momentum as well. Other than that stand, nothing much was worth writing about, except for Pakistan's bowling in this innings.

Chasing 306 to win, Sri Lanka got off to a horror start before two lesser known players got them back on track. Well, in front of the target, they were always behind the 8-ball but at least, that 177-run stand gave them some respect and hope. Either side of that partnership, only 61 runs were added. Shehan Jayasuriya was playing a calm knock but it was Dasun Shanaka who injected some momentum into the chase.

Where did this match end? When Babar scored a century? When Pakistan crossed 300? When Sri Lanka were 28/5? Tough to say. Looking at the fight shown by Shanaka and Jayasuriya, if the top order had contributed a bit more, who knows, we might have had a different result.

Right. The first complete ODI in Karachi in a long while. And Pakistan come out victorious. Not a surprise to many but that record 6th-wicket stand between Shanaka and Jayasuriya almost gave some other ideas.

OUT! Caught! That ends the game. PAKISTAN WIN BY 67 RUNS TO TAKE A 1-0 lead in the now turned 2-match series. A tossed up ball outside off, Hasaranga swings it towards deep mid-wicket but does not quite connect well. Iftikhar Ahmed comes running in from deep mid-wicket and pouches it, albeit a bit too quickly. The ball almost pops out but he controls it.
Dropped short, pulled through mid-wicket for a brace again.
Comes down the track once again and skews it over the infield, towards point. A couple more taken.
Outside off, Hasaranga gets down and initially lets it go but then looks to play the late dab. Is too late and gets beaten.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
Nuwan Pradeep is the last man in. What can he do to add some more respect to the already respectable fightback from Sri Lanka?

OUT! LBW! Number 9 goes down. Looked a harsh call to the naked eye but Sri Lanka do not have any review left. A length ball, around middle and off, cutting back in sharply, Kumara jumped to defend but was beaten by pace. The ball skidded back sharply and caught him on the pads, Riaz appealed and the umpire raised his finger. Well... Ball Tracker shows it to be hitting leg. Perhaps Kumara expected a short ball.
Landed outside off, Kumara gets across and shoulders arms.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
FOUR! Nicely struck. A length ball outside off, Hasaranga leans and lofts it as cleanly as a whistle, over cover for a boundary.
A full toss, wide outside off, played straight to point.
Around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

That is slow, tossed up outside off and then turning away a mile, just like it would, in a play station game. (Ahh...those were the days) WH swings wildly and misses. 14 from the over but a good comeback from Shadab.
Shorter in length this time, a pull shot attempted, missed again.
Outside off, Hasaranga attempts a wild slog, only to miss.

SIX! CLOUT! Excellent connection. Shadab has been taken to the cleaners tonight. Full and outside off, Hasaranga comes down the track and hits this as straight as an arrow, over the bowler, in front of the sightscreen!

Looks to go big again but this time Shadab smartly throws it wider outside off. Wanindu is halfway down the track, nowhere near the pitch of the ball and luckily, he connects. Even though he top edges it, it is in no man's land, well wide of the jogging Imad from extra cover. Two runs taken.
SIX! That is a glorious shot. Tossed up outside off, Hasaranga, himself a leg spinner, steps out, gets to the pitch of the ball and plays it with the turn over extra cover!
Shadab Khan returns. 8-0-56-1 so far.
Outside off, flayed straight to point.
Slower ball again, outside off, Kumara swings but misses.
Trying to get the yorker in, extending himself, but it turns out to be a low full toss around leg stump. The tail-ender pushes this back to the bowler.
Outside off, a push and a miss.
Nicely done. A length ball outside off, Hasaranga arches back and deftly guides this wide of the slip cordon towards third man for a single.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
Wahab Riaz time. 7-0-20-0 so far.
Landed outside off, Kumara has a wild slog, only to miss. End of a wonderful spell of bowling - 10-1-51-5.
Lahiru Kumara walks in at number 10, replacing Udana.

OUT! Edged and caught behind. Lion-hearted effort from Usman Shinwari as he bags his second ODI 5-fer on a flat deck. He has come in and run very hard on a highway, as if to question the selectors, as to why, o why, was I left out of the World Cup squad. A slower ball, outside off, cutting away, Udana backs away and slogs hard, only managing a thick outside edge. Simple catch for Sarfaraz Ahmed.
Full and around middle, Udana swings hard but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. The ball deflects towards cover.
Pushes this through mid on for a single.

High, high, high but not long. Luckily for the batsman, does not carry to the fielder. A length ball around middle, slower in pace, Hasaranga is early into his slog and the ball hits the toe end of his bat. Goes high in the air, but clears mid on, who cannot get to it even after running behind. Two runs taken.
WIDE. A nasty bouncer, following the batsman, but too high, down the leg side, from around the wicket. Hasaranga just about sways out in time.
A length ball around off, solidly defended.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run. 2 runs and a wicket from the over, 5/2 in the last 2.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Full and outside off, driven towards cover once again.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Short and fast outside off, Udana swivels to pull but misses.
Isuru Udana walks in at number 9 as suddenly, the match is hastening towards the close.

OUT! Caught! That is a stunning catch from Fakhar Zaman. In the twinkle of an eye, both Batman and Robin have disappeared.  First, Jayasuriya. Now, Shanaka. Short and outside off, Dasun rocks back and pulls it. The ball seems to be dipping towards deep mid-wicket but Fakhar Zaman comes running in and dives forward to take a brilliant catch. A fine 68 from Shanaka, his highest ODI score. Sadly for him and his team, this match is over.
Shadab Khan is back on. 7-0-54-0 so far.
Around off, solidly defended from the crease. 3 runs and a wicket from the over, Shinwari's figures read 9-1-47-4!
Now come the power-hitters. Wanindu Hasaranga steps in at number 8.

OUT! Caught behind! No century for Jayasuriya. No double century stand. The 6th wicket stand has finally been broken. Usman gets his fourth. A length ball outside off, Shehan looks to push but misses. The ball goes behind, generating some noise and Sarfaraz immediately appeals. The umpire consents and Shehan walks back disappointed. He tried hard but the task was too mountainous for him. A fantastic 96 from a position where Sri Lanka were down and out at 28/5. Now, they need 102 from 55 balls.
Full and around middle, swung towards mid-wicket for one.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Down the leg side, flicked away for a run.
Full and around middle, swung towards wide long on for a single.
POWERPLAY 3 time! 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle. Pakistan scored 89 from here. Sri Lanka need 105. Could we go down the wire?
Good fielding! A slower one on middle, the batter shuffles across and then hits it down towards fine leg. The fielder there runs to his right, dives and keeps it down to one. 104 needed in 60.
On the shorter side outside off, Shehan hops and guides it down to third man for one.
A short one on middle, it is ducked under.
On middle, this is worked around the corner for one. 200 up for Sri Lanka.
That was pacey! Shorter and closer to the body of the batter. Cramping him for room. Shanaka looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
Good length outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Wahab Riaz is back on! His figures so far 6-0-16-0.
A yorker which Shehan watches till the end and jams it down to third man for another single.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
A wild swing! A slower one outside off, Shanaka looks to heave it across the line but misses.
One more delivery angled into the batter, Shehan flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
This is angled into the batter, Shanaka works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
So once again the lights have gone off and yet again there is a halt in play. Let us hope the issue is once again solved quickly. The issue has been solved and we are all set for the action now.
Good length and on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Usman Shinwari is back into the attack. 7-1-39-3 his figures so far.

FOUR! 13 from the over! Quicker one, fullish and on off, Dasun gives it the full whack of his bat and powers it over mid off for a boundary. This is also the highest sixth wicket stand for Sri Lanka in ODIs and also against Pakistan by any team for the same wicket.
Beautiful leg spinner. Landing around off, Shanaka pushes at it and misses.
Flatter leg spinner on middle, Jayasuriya quietly nudges it to the right of short fine leg for one.
FOUR! Flighted leg spinner, landing around leg, Shehan flicks it off his pads and gets it fine past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
YAYYYY!!!!!!! The floodlight is switched on again. All in readiness. Shadab Khan to continue...

Play halted! Reason? One of the floodlights has stopped illuminating completely. Now, this is the last thing you want on a cricket field. Pakistan will hope that this forced break will hamper Sri Lanka's progress and steal their momentum. The players are taking this opportunity to relax. Equation - 122 needed off 76 balls.

Missed stumping chance! FOUR! Just not Shadab's day today. The batter comes down the track and that is spotted by the bowler. He fires it full outside off. Jayasuriya reaches out for it. It goes off the outside edge between the legs of Sarfaraz and down to the third man fence.
This lands on middle and then turns back in. Shehan looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but not given.
Slightly short and on middle, Jayasuriya kneels and hits it with a horizontal bat to deep square leg for a single.
Loopy and full around off, Shehan plays the reverse sweep but finds the point fielder.
Short in length and outside off, stroked from the back foot to deep cover for one.

FOUR! 150-run stand comes up! There is still hope for Sri Lanka if this pair continues and last the distance. Pakistan under a bit of stress now. Imad fires in a flatter arm ball around off, Shanaka uses the angle to his advantage and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Goes quicker and flatter this time, Jayasuriya flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Jayasuriya is growing in confidence with every run! He shimmies down the track this time, fetches a full ball from outside off and spanks it over the bowler's head for a boundary at long on.
A quicker short one on the middle pole, Shanaka mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket. A dot to end but Shadab continues leaking runs.
In the air... but safe! Shorter and on middle, Jayasuriya looks to pull but gets a top edge which lands safe in the deep square leg region for one.

In the air... just over! FOUR! Shehan is now going after every ball here. He brings out the reverse sweep now. The ball though takes the top edge due to the extra bounce. Goes over the outstretched hand of Amir at short third man who tries taking it awkwardly. He initially moves to his right but then tries taking it with his left hand. He fails to do so and a boundary results.
Shehan comes down the track and swings. It goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for two.
WIDE! Down the leg side, the batter looks to flick but misses.

A big swing and a miss! Shortish and on off, Shanaka goes for the pull but the ball turns away. Sarfaraz fails to collect it and it hits the shoulder of the keeper goes towards short third man. A bye taken.
Nicely played! This is flatter and outside off, Shehan waits for it and then guides it down towards third man for three.
Shadab Khan is back on! 5-0-30-0 his figures so far.
GoaRocks - 'Sri Lanka should consider sending these two to open in future...'

FOUR! Shanaka gets to his fifty in great fashion! A fighting knock by him. He was struggling when he came to the wicket first but now looks good. He gets a freebie to get to the milestone. Short and outside off, he cuts it behind point and it races away to the fence. Also, the last ball spoils the over somewhat. 6 from it.
SJ comes down the track but gets too close to the pitch of the ball, he hits it down to long off for one.
Gives it a lot of flight now and lands it outside off, Jayasuriya hits it hard but to covers again.
Fuller and outside off, this is hit hard to covers.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
On off, this is kept out.
Imad Wasim is back! 5-1-21-1 his figures so far.
A slower one, a dipping full toss outside off. Shanaka gets bat on ball, it goes off the outer half towards third man for one.
Shanaka makes room and Wahab follows him. DS looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On the shorter side again, this is pulled through square leg for one. 150 up for the Lankans.
Two! Shorter and around off, this is guided behind point. They take one and then go for the second. Complete it.
Shorter and outside off, Jayasuriya looks to cut but misses.

Shehan Jayasuriya is on the ground! Looks to be more of a cramp, to be honest. Sri Lanka need this pair to carry on and on. They have done a fabulous job but the task is a monumental one. This could just be the break which might change the momentum in Pakistan's favour. it is 34 degrees but feels like 41. Terribly hot. Thankfully, the sun has set, else it would have felt like 82.
On the shorter side and on the body, this is pulled through backward square leg. There should have been a run but it is a dot as Shehan Jayasuriya is down on the ground. Maybe suffering from cramps.
A slower one on middle, it is kept out.
A yorker outside off, this is jammed out towards third man for one.

FOUR! Over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence! No one in the deep, picked his spot well here. This is angled into the batter. Shehan Jayasuriya whips it, it goes just over the leaping fielder and into the fence. A boundary after almost 5 overs.
Back of a length on off, Shanaka drops it towards cover for one.
Direct hit and it could have been close! A slower one on the pads, it is worked towards short fine leg. The batters go for one. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
A short one and on the body, Shehan looks to pull but misses it.

Drinks break. The century partnership between Shehan Jayasuriya and Dasun Shanaka has offered good resistance in this run chase. Winning this match is still a longggggg way away but Sri Lanka will be pleased with the effort of their boys. 166 needed off 108 balls and it's not impossible to achieve. However, it's just a matter of one wicket for Pakistan. Let's see how this run chase finishes.
Good length delivery on middle, Shanaka defends it to mid-wicket.
On a length on middle, Jayasuriya flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
On a good length on middle, Jayasuriya nudges it to leg side.
Length delivery on middle, Shanaka flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Length delivery on leg, Shanaka looks to flick but gets it off his pads. It goes towards square leg. The batsmen get two runs. The umpire gives it as leg byes.
On a length on middle, Shanaka flicks it to mid-wicket.
Wahab Riaz is back on now! His figures so far 4-0-10-0.
Full delivery on middle, Jayasuriya looks to keep it out but gets an inside edge. It goes close past the leg pole and towards short fine leg.
Length delivery on off, Jayasuriya looks to play a lofted shot but gets a top edge. It goes over mid off. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Length delivery on middle, Shanaka nudges it towards square leg for a run.
Bowls a yorker just outside off, Shanaka tries to dig it out but misses it. It was just close to the off stump.
Good length delivery on off, Shanaka defends it out.
Full delivery on middle, Jayasuriya flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A rash shot but no harm done! This is on a length and around off, Shanaka looks to hit it over mid on but mistimes it. It goes on the bounce to mid on.
Good length and on off, this is defended onto the ground.
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for two.
Shortish around off, Shanaka stands tall and pulls it hard to mid on. This is a shot of a man in good confidence.
One more length delivery around off, this is guided down towards third man for one.

100-run stand up between the pair. Also, fifty for Jayasuriya! His first in ODIs and a good time to bring it up. His team was down and out but he and Shanaka have actually showed some fight. Still a long way to go though. Shorter and outside off, SJ cuts it behind point. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, dives and seems to have pushed it back in. The umpire takes it upstairs and the replays show that he has done well. Two taken.
A single to end! Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A slower one on middle, it is angled into the batter. He looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Another length ball on middle, this is hit to the man at mid on.
Good length and on middle, defended.
Slower one on the pads, it is worked behind square on the leg side for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Mohammad Amir is back on! 4-1-8-1 his figures so far.
A single to end! This is on off, it is pushed to mid off. 18 from the over. An expensive return for Usman into the attack.
SIX! Dismissed! 14 from the last three balls. This is short and it is a slower one. It sits up to be hit. Shanaka picks the length early and powers it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Fine on the leg side this time. This is on the pads, Shanaka tickles it fine and bags another boundary. Consecutive ones.

EDGY FOUR! Sri Lanka won't mind how they come as long as they do. This is a length ball from around the wicket on off. Shanaka looks to defend but does so inside the line, it goes off the outside edge fine to the third man fence.
Shortish again and on the body, it is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two.
Usman Shinwari is back into the attack. 5-1-16-3 his figures so far.
A dot to end another good over for Sri Lanka. On middle, this is kept out.
Shorter and on middle, it is pulled through square leg for one. Runs needed less than 200 now.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Slower through the air outside off, Jayasuriya lunges and tries to defend but the ball turns back in. It hits the inside edge and deflects onto the pads.

SIX! That has gone a long way! Straight back over the bowler's head. They might be targeting Shadab here. Jayasuriya into the 40s. He comes down the track again and gets to the pitch of it. Lofts it and clears the long off fence with ease.
Flatter and outside off, it is worked with the turn towards square leg.
This lands on middle and turns back in. The batter looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
On off, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Shortish and on off, Shanaka chops it to covers.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg, away from the fielder in the deep for two. 100 up for Sri Lanka.
Flatter and on off, this is kept out.

FOUR! Hammered! Excellent use of the feet again but this time by Jayasuriya. He gets to the pitch of it and smashes it straight down the ground for a boundary. End of a top over for Sri Lanka. They need a few more of such overs.
Just short! A leg spinner on off, it stops in the surface. Jayasuriya is early in the flick. It goes off the leading edge but short of Shadab who dives forward to take it.
On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! That is an effortless shot! Lovely use of the feet and extension of the arms. Uses his feet and gets to the pitch of it. Nonchalantly lifts it over the long on fence.
Tosses it up on off, Shanaka pushes it to covers.
The slider on off, Shanaka gets his bat down in time and pushes it to covers.
Fires in a flatter full ball on middle, Shehan helps it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
Flatter delivery outside off, Shehan plays a late cut but finds short third man.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Quicker and shorter on off, punched back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Shehan goes back to cut but it takes the outside edge and rolls to short third man.
Aerial but safe! Jayasuriya flicks it with the spin but fails to keep it down. It flies wide of mid-wicket and the batsmen take a single.

Appeal for an lbw! Not given. Tossed up ball on off, turning back in, Jayasuriya tries to flick but misses. He is struck on the pads, they appeal but nothing from the umpire. Turning too much and would have missed the leg stump, quips Alan Wilkins on air.
Loopy and around off, turning away, Shehan tries playing across the line but it takes the leading edge and rolls to covers.
Fuller and on off, eased through mid off for one.
Full and flighted on middle, Dasun defends it by pressing forward.
Loopy and on off, it's blocked off the front foot.
Goes on the back foot and punches it down the ground. The short mid-wicket fielder intervenes and makes a dive to stop the ball. Maiden over!
Tossed up ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Flighted and on off, worked on the leg side but straight to short mid-wicket.
Loopy and full on off, it's defended back.
Good stop by the bowler! Quicker on off, punched back towards Iftikhar who dived to his left to make the stop.
Flatter one on off, punched from the back foot to short cover.
Too full and on leg, it's eased down through mid on for a single.
Flighted ball on off, it's flicked with the spin to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
A full toss outside off, Shehan goes hard at it but fails to beat the mid off fielder.
Spinning down the leg side from the middle stump line, Shehan fails to flick it off his pads.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Jayasuriya has played it towards mid-wicket.
Flighted and on off, Shehan gets forward and works it to mid-wicket.
Another delivery spinning down the leg side, it's helped towards fine leg for one.
Wide! Turning down the leg side, the batsman leaves it.
Flatter one, short and on off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Loopy and full outside off, Jayasuriya strokes it past the diving cover fielder for a brace. 50-run stand comes up. Finally, some fight from the Lankans.
Flighted and fuller outside off, it's forced off the front foot but straight to the cover fielder.
FOUR! Well played in the end! Shortish delivery, wide outside off, Shanaka rocks back and delays his square cut just a bit. Does well eventually to get it away wide of backward point for a boundary.
Beauty of a delivery! Plenty of drift on this one. It lands on middle and spins away sharply to beat the attempted defensive bat of Shanaka. That wasn't too far away from the off pole.
Flatter and shorter around leg, it's hit through square leg for one.
Loopy and too full on leg, Jayasuriya sweeps it fine down the leg side. The fielder makes a good stop near the fence and the batsmen take two.
Gets on the front foot and drives it with the spin through covers for one.
Tossed up ball outside off, Dasun watches the line closely and makes a leave.
Shadab Khan is on now!
A slower one to end outside off, DS strokes it through covers for one.
On the body again, Shanaka looks to pull but is beaten by pace.
Nicely played! Waits for the ball to come to him and then guides it behind point for one.
Good length again on off, this is pushed to mid off.

A mix-up but safe! Good length and on middle, this is hit back past the bowler. The mid off fielder gives it a chase and manages to pull it back in. The batters take two. Jayasuriya wants a third but is sent back in time.

A loud shout but not given! Shanaka shuffles right across as Wahab lands this one around leg. DS looks to whip but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but it is turned  down. A leg bye is taken as the ball rolls towards mid-wicket. That was high and the pitching was also an issue.
Flatter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
On the fuller side, it is eased down to long on for one.
Good fielding! This is worked wide of mid-wicket. The fielder there dives to his left and stops a run.
Slows it up and lands it on off, it turns back in. The batter looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flatter and on off, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Very full and on off, Shanaka strokes it down to long off and takes one.

FOUR LEG BYES! Wahab digs in another sharp short delivery in the line of the stumps. Shehan goes down to duck but it takes his gloves and balloons over first slip for a boundary. The umpire probably missed the gloves and gives it as leg byes.
Shanaka opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. One run added to the total.

IN THE AIR... SAFE! Dasun Shanaka is struggling big time in the middle. Wahab bangs in a short ball on off, a well-directed one, Shanaka is caught in a tangle while dealing it. Tries to move away but it takes the shoulder of his bat and loops towards covers. The fielder from inside the ring charges forward but it drops in front of him. Babar Azam was the fielder.
Full in length and around off, it's driven off the front foot to mid off.
Back of a length ball on off, Dasun stays back and taps it down to point.
Fullish and on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it with the spin to covers.

Once again it's aerial but safe! Imad slows it up in the air and lands it full on middle. Dasun once again tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It grabs the leading edge and goes wide of the cover fielder. Hurries down to long off for a single.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for a single.
Aerial but safe! Loopy full ball landing around off, Shanaka tries to flick but gets a leading edge on it. It flies through the gap at covers for a single.
Fetches a shortish ball from outside off and wrists it behind square leg for a run. 50 comes up for Sri Lanka.
Goes on the back foot and punches it towards cover-point.
Bouncer again, no mercy shown by the bowler. It's around leg and this time Shanaka makes a clean leave. Lets it go to the keeper.

Drinks break. Dasun Shanaka is getting the attention of the physio. Meanwhile, let's quickly summarize this run chase so far. It's been all Pakistan from the word go. Mohammad Amir and Usman Shinwari were brilliant with the new balls and didn't waste much time in running through the top half of the Lankan batting. This match is firmly in the home side's favour and the Islanders would be hoping for some sort of a fight from the remaining batsmen.

Ouch, that would have hurt! A half-tracker around middle and off, Shanaka crouches as he tries to lean back and get away from the line of fire. But he fails to move his body out and takes a blow on his chest. Looks winded. Physio is called and the umpires take that opportunity to call for Drinks.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR LEG BYES! Good length ball angling down the leg side, Dasun tries flicking but misses. It clips his thigh pad and flies past the diving keeper for a boundary behind.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Another flatter and shorter ball on off, this time Shehan punches it wide of the short mid-wicket fielder and sends it down to long on for a single.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Jayasuriya punches it off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball outside off, Shehan once again allows it through to the keeper.
Fullish and on off, clipped on the leg side but straight to short mid-wicket.
Flighted again, this time the length is not too full as it lands outside off. Jayasuriya makes a watchful leave and then does the shadow practice of a square cut.
FOUR! Flighted delivery, landing full outside off, Shehan kneels down, fetches it from out there and nails his sweep shot behind square leg. Looking in fine form, Jayasuriya.
Fuller one on the pads, it's eased behind square leg for a run.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Sliding down the leg side, Shehan uses his wrists and flicks it in the gap at deep mid-wicket. Two runs taken comfortably.
Back of a length ball on off, Shehan sticks back again and opens the face of the bat to play it towards point.
On a length and around off, Jayasuriya stays back and pushes it to covers.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wahab Riaz is into the attack now.

FIVE RUNS! Floated ball landing full outside off, Jayasuriya pushes it with gentle hands to the right of the cover fielder. They cross for a run as the fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end. No one is backing it up and the ball speeds away to the fence at long on.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Beaten! Nicely flighted delivery. It lands on a fuller length outside off and goes straight on. Dasun plays for the arm ball and is beaten.
Flatter and a touch shorter outside off, Jayasuriya punches it through covers and takes a single.
Quicker arm ball, full and around off, Shanaka tries to defend but it takes the inner half and rolls in front of square leg for a single.
Wow. This guy is playing. Dasun Shanaka comes out to bat at number 7, when he did not bowl even a single ball. Where is that Shanaka who terrorised India sometime in 2016?

OUT! LBW! The decision stays as it is and Sri Lanka suffer two strikes in one blow - Oshada and a review. The arm ball, pitched outside off, Oshada looks to defend but completely misses the line of the ball. He looks to play with the angle, towards the leg side but misses the line. Is hit on the pads and Imad runs towards the keeper in half-appeal and celebration. The umpire takes his time and raises his finger. Surprisingly, the batsman takes the review. Nothing much to chew. The first wicket to a spinner this innings. Will Powerplay 3 dawn upon us tonight?

That is out. Dead plumb LBW. Oshada Fernando has been adjudged by the umpire but he has taken the review. Looks stone dead even in the replays. Nothing on the Ultra Edge. Three reds according to Ball Tracker. Half the side gone, on 10.1.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. IF the game lasts till then.
A mistimed back foot punch by Shehan and he finds the cover fielder. Sri Lanka are 28/4 at the end of Powerplay 1. Pakistan were 47/0 at this stage. Comfortably on top!
Shortish and close to off, Oshada gets forward with an angled bat and guides it to third man for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Nearly a drag on! A good length ball just outside off, Shehan turns inside the crease to swing it across the line. It takes the inside edge, beats the stumps and hurries down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Jayasuriya stands on his toes and taps it down to cover-point.
FOUR! Shinwari errs in line and pays the price. A length ball sliding down the leg side, Shehan deflects it neatly off his pads to the fine leg fence.
Quicker and shorter one just outside off, Oshada cuts it late but fails to get it past short third man. A good diving stop there. Maiden from Imad Wasim!
Floated one, full and around off, Oshada lunges and defends it to the off side.
Arm ball landing just outside off and skidding back in, Fernando defends it near his front pad.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Advances down the track and digs a full ball back to the bowler.
Flatter arm ball on off, Oshada defends it back off the front foot.
Shehan Jayasuriya walks in at number 6 as Sri Lanka begin their passage of all-rounders. Meanwhile, Imad Wasim to bowl the first over of spin in this run chase.

OUT! Lazy Lahiru! Clean catch from Sarfaraz. Sri Lanka slip further. Shinwari is on a wicket-taking spree. He delivers it on a length and outside off. Seeing the width on offer, Thirimanne decides to have a go. He has his weight on the back leg as he throws his bat at the ball. But to his bad luck, it takes the inner portion of the blade before flying behind. Sarfaraz goes down low to catch it inches above the surface. The appeal is made but the umpire wants to get it checked upstairs. The soft signal is given as out. Time for the replays and just one frame is enough to confirm that Thirimanne is a goner. Poor shot selection from the skipper and he has left the sinking ship without any fight. A double-wicket maiden!

Lahiru Thirimanne is caught behind! The umpire though wants to check it upstairs. Has that carried? To the naked eye, it did look so. The soft signal is OUT. Here comes the replay. No problem with the front foot landing. There is a noise as the ball passes the bat. And oh yes, the ball has carried straight into the mitts. The Sri Lankan captain is already three-quarters of his way back to the pavillion but he just stops to look back at the giant screen. And he gets three letters. O. U. T.
Bouncer around middle and leg, Thirimanne ducks to let it through.
Fullish and close to off, Lahiru has his bat down in time to block it towards mid off.
Skipper Lahiru Thirimanne walks out to the middle with Sri Lanka in a spot of bother.

OUT! Caught at mid off! Once again a soft dismissal. Shinwari hurls in a fuller length ball around off, skidding away from the batsman. Avishka is early into his shot and chips his attempted off drive in the air. Fakhar Zaman takes the simplest of catches at mid off and it's the worst possible start for Sri Lanka in this run chase.
Another length delivery in the line of the stumps, Avishka pushes it out from the back foot. The extra cover fielder makes the stop on this occasion.
Good length ball outside off, Avishka punches it from the back foot towards mid off.
Two slips and a gully in place.

Uppish but safe! This one probably stops onto the batsman a bit and Oshada is early into his shot. He checks it at the last moment and pushes it aerially towards mid on. Doesn't carry to the fielder. A wicket maiden for Amir!
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Fullish and outside off, moving back in a bit, Oshada leans forward for a drive through covers but then has to adjust to push it towards mid off.
Angling away from the batsman, on a good length, Oshada shoulders arms.
Oshada Fernando joins another Fernando in the middle.

OUT! Slower one fools the batsman there. A 118.4 kph delivery, landing on a fuller length and outside off. Gunathilaka leans forward and across for the flick shot but is way too early into his shot. The ball arrives late, takes the inner half of the willow and settles into the safe hands of Imad Wasim at mid on. A soft dismissal really. Sri Lanka have both their openers back in the hut. 284 needed off 263 balls.
Good length ball on top of off stump, Avishka defends it from the back foot to covers.
Bunts a full ball in front of mid on and scampers across to the other end. The fielder has a shy but misses the stumps at the bowler's end.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. Third dot in a row.

A muted appeal for an lbw! Too high. Not given and Sarfaraz is not interested in taking the DRS either. Slightly short and around off, skidding into the batsman, Gunathilaka is on the back foot attempting to work it around but is beaten for pace. He is rapped on the front leg but it's too high.
On middle, angling in, Gunathilaka flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Speedy delivery, cutting back in from a length, Gunathilaka brings his bat down and it takes the inner portion of his blade. Runs through square leg for a couple of runs.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it towards mid on.

Oh my dear... Imam-ul-Haq is seen in the dressing room, with Waqar Younis and Misbah-ul-Haq. He was walking off the field due to a split webbing, but his portion from the palm to almost the elbow is plastered! That looks more like a split webbing.
Lands it on a length around off, shaping away, Avishka stays back to defend it towards the cover-point fielder.
Bowls a length ball close to off stump, Fernando defends it close to his body.
In the zone outside off, Danushka goes after it away from his body and edges it down to third man for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gunathilaka has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Who is the number 3 batsman? It's the promising Avishka Fernando. He enjoyed a brilliant World Cup and would like to build a name for himself on this tour.

OUT! Timberrrrrrr... A 141.2 kph delivery. Shinwari has once again struck with the new ball for Pakistan. He lands it on a length around middle and gets it to nip back into the batsman off the seam. Samarawickrama with minimum front foot movement tries to keep it out with a straight bat but it takes the inside half of his bat and pegs the leg stump back. Boom! Shinwari roars in joy. The crowd also joins him.
Lands it on a fuller length around middle and off, Samarawickrama brings his bat down in defense and pushes it out off the inner half to short mid-wicket.
Beaten! Back of a length ball around off, shaping away, Sadeera rocks back to pull it across the line but fails to make any connection.

EDGY FOUR! No second slip present and Samarawickrama gets away with a poor shot. Fuller in length delivery outside off, Sadeera spots the room and goes hard at it with the intention to blaze it through covers. But the ball catches the outside edge and screams past the right side of the first slip fielder. A boundary results.
Shortish and on off, punched from the back foot to covers.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Imam is off the field! He seems to have split his webbing while doing the last piece of fielding. Heading off to the pavilion to receive some treatment.

Shot! A good half-stop by Imam also. A length ball around off, leaving the batsman with the angle, Sadeera forces it from the crease and Imam at cover-point goes down low to his left to stop the racing ball. Since it's not a clean stop, the batsmen cross. The point fielder mops it up.
Good length ball on off, angling away along with staying low, Samarawickrama keeps his eyes on the ball and blocks it back safely.
Skiddy delivery. Around leg, Sadeera tries to flick but misses. It goes behind to the left of the keeper and the striker looks for a run. He is sent back.
Pitches it up and outside off, Samarawickrama drives it from the toe end of his bat to covers. Straightaway has a look at the toe end of his bat and wants to get it changed.
On and around off, a full length ball, Sadeera is forward in defense.
Wide! Another delivery on the leg stump line, further going down, Samarawickrama tries to flick but misses. Sarfaraz collects it with a slight fumble.
On the pads, it's worked on the leg side but straight to square leg.

FOUR! Finds the gap superbly! Shinwari dishes out a delivery on the leg stump line, Gunathilaka picks it off his pads and clips it through square leg for a glorious boundary. Didn't bother to keep it down.

Quick run. A length ball around off, slanting in, Danushka pushes it with gentle hands towards extra cover and rushes to the other end. The fielder rushes to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Another run taken as an overthrow.
Hits the deck hard and angles in a length ball on off, Danushka strides ahead and pushes it towards mid on.
Hurls a length ball in the channel outside off, Gunathilaka takes his front leg forward to cover the line and then makes a watchful leave.
Slightly off the mark this time. Back of a length ball around leg, Sadeera works it behind square leg and takes a single.
Starts his spell with a fuller length ball around off, Samarawickrama gets on the front foot and pushes it back to the bowler.
Usman Shinwari to steam in with the second new ball from the other end. He missed the ticket to World Cup and has a point to prove here to the selectors.
Goes wider of the crease and angles it into the pads, Gunathilaka pushes it to mid on. So 5 dots after the wide ball.
One more ball on  a length and around off, it is kept out again.
One more good length ball on off, Gunathilaka guides it to point.
Outside off, it is left alone.
This is angled into the pads, it is worked to mid on.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side, the batter looks to flick but misses.
FOUR! Perfect start for Sri Lanka! Excellent shot. This is a half volley outside off. Amir does get it to swing away. Gunathilaka leans into it and creams it through extra cover for a boundary.
We are back for the chase! The Sri Lankan openers Danushka Gunathilaka and Sadeera Samarawickrama make their way out to the middle. For Pakistan, Mohammad Amir will start with the first new ball.
